summary: bool, bool | int, typing.Optionalbool, etc. Calling a function with boolean positional arguments is confusing as the meaning of the boolean value is not clear to the caller and to future readers of the code. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-boolean-trap and made it stable in v0.0.127.
